Skull — MR Viewer

The 3D skull is loaded. Press the button — it appears floating in front of you, and you control it with your hands.

🤏Pinch to place it on a surface
🙌Pinch both hands, move apart/together to zoom
✋Pinch ONE hand & move: up/down tilts, left/right spins
Tip: enable Hand Tracking on your Quest (Settings → Movement tracking). Put the controllers down and just use your hands.
Pinch your fingers to place the skull on a surface.
